area_one_validity: a_s=1 is valid exactly only among recovered positive exponent words; necessarily 1<=s<=L-q-1.

H133.statement: Exclude every remaining positive nontrivial cycle profile, including larger-area coprime and general noncoprime profiles.

P133.statement: At a primitive positive cycle minimum, every proper full-shortcut prefix coefficient exceeds lambda, and m(1-lambda)<q/3.

P134.statement: Every nontrivial primitive positive cycle satisfies q>170m or lambda>1/2 and L=ceil(q log2 3).

P135.statement: For gcd(L,q)=1, cyclic exponent classes correspond to valid residue-indexed nonnegative profiles, and D|B iff A_a(gamma)=0 mod D.

P136.statement: A coprime area-zero profile yields only (q,L)=(1,2), the trivial positive cycle.

P137.statement: D divides the nonzero resultant for every integral coprime profile, while the resultant magnitude is at most the q/2 power of its radial energy.

P138.statement: Every positive coprime area-one profile is excluded; the critical q>=13 part depends on EXT05, while noncritical q>=4 is internal and all smaller cases are exact finite checks.

P139.statement: Under EXT15, every non-Christoffel coprime class has C_min<=C_chr-g with g>3^(q-1)/4.

P140.statement: For gcd(L,q)=d>1, D0=2^(L/d)-3^(q/d) divides D and an integral word obeys a grouped degree-(q/d-1) modular polynomial and resultant condition.

external_bound: EXT05 is used only on the critical cancellation line q>12; no repository reproof of Lemma B.1 is claimed.
integrality_legality: For D>0, D|B makes x=B/D an odd integer; the unique parity cylinder modulo 2^L then forces the literal exponent word. Primitive period is checked separately.
map: odd accelerated x_(i+1)=(3*x_i+1)/2^e_i with exact e_i=v2(3*x_i+1)
noncoprime_boundary: P140 is only a weaker necessary condition modulo D0; it is not a bijective coprime profile theorem and does not eliminate the noncoprime branch.
profile_orientation: Rotate to the unique minimum of H_j=qE_j-Lj; profile indices are residues r=H_j mod q, not time indices j.
resultant_convention: Res(X^q-2,A_a); X^q-2 is Eisenstein at 2, so the resultant is nonzero because deg(A_a)<q.
slope_root: For uq+vL=1, gamma=2^u3^v mod D satisfies gamma^q=2 and gamma^L=3; negative powers mean modular inverses.
what_this_result_does_not_prove: It does not exclude all positive nontrivial cycles, H89, H112, H72, or prove Collatz.
